stemMd: What new information emerged during the site visit?

options.label: A
options.textMd: The window could never admit any light

options.label: B
options.textMd: The neighbouring land had permission for a new building

options.label: C
options.textMd: The apartment had no external wall

options.label: D
options.textMd: The garden was guaranteed to remain open forever

options.label: E
options.textMd: The designer had completed the neighbouring building

explanationMd: The permitted neighbouring development introduced a plausible change in the surroundings. It affected the interpretation of the original bright garden view without establishing that the window would become useless.

distractorRationale.c: An existing window was to be enlarged.
distractorRationale.a: The passage says it would still admit light.
